title: Oplax monoidal descent through a compatible lax monoidal square
statement:
Use the monoidal-functor conventions of [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]. Let $K_1,K_2,D_1,D_2$ be monoidal categories, $Q_1:K_1\to D_1$ and $Q_2:K_2\to D_2$ lax monoidal functors, $F:K_1\to K_2$ an oplax monoidal functor, and $G:D_1\to D_2$ a functor. Write $\mu_Q:QX\otimes QY\to Q(X\otimes Y)$ and $\varepsilon_Q:\mathbf1\to Q\mathbf1$ for lax maps, and $\delta_F:F(X\otimes Y)\to FX\otimes FY$ and $\eta_F:F\mathbf1\to\mathbf1$ for oplax maps. Let $\delta_{X,Y}:G(X\otimes Y)\to GX\otimes GY$ be natural in both variables, and let $e_a:GQ_1a\to Q_2Fa$ be a natural family of isomorphisms satisfying
$$\delta_{Q_1a,Q_1b};(e_a\otimes e_b);\mu_{Q_2;Fa,Fb}=G(\mu_{Q_1;a,b});e_{a\otimes b};Q_2(\delta_{F;a,b}).$$
Here semicolons denote composition in written order. Assume $\varepsilon_{Q_2}$ is invertible. Let $S$ be a class of objects of $K_1$ such that every object of $D_1$ is isomorphic to $Q_1a$ for some $a\in S$, and such that $\mu_{Q_2;x,Fb}$ is invertible for every $x\in K_2$ and $b\in S$. Then $G$ has the oplax monoidal structure with tensor comparison $\delta$ and unit
$$G(\varepsilon_{Q_1});e_{\mathbf1};Q_2(\eta_F);\varepsilon_{Q_2}^{-1}.$$
No braiding is required; $Q_1$ need only be lax monoidal.

source.place: CategoryTheory.Functor.OplaxMonoidal.ofLaxSquare and its associativity and unit helper lemmas

proof.text: Define the unit and tensor comparison by the displayed composites and δ. Naturality of the tensor comparison is the given naturality in each variable.

For three model objects Q1(a),Q1(b),Q1(c), postcompose the oplax associativity equation with the inverse target associator, e(a)⊗e(b)⊗e(c), μ(Q2,Fa,Fb) tensor identity, and μ(Q2,Fa⊗Fb,Fc). Both tensorators are invertible when b,c∈S. Substitute the compatibility equation twice on each side, moving factors with naturality of e and μ. Lax associativity for Q1 and Q2 and oplax associativity for F identify the two resulting composites. Cancel the invertible postcomposition. Transport the identity from models to arbitrary objects by precomposing with G of the tensor of three model isomorphisms and using naturality of δ and the associator. This is oplax_associativity_of_lax_square followed by oplax_associativity_of_iso.

For the left unit on Q1(a), substitute the displayed unit. Use compatibility at (1,a), naturality of e, and lax left unitality for Q1 and Q2 to reduce to oplax left unitality for F. Cancel the unit isomorphism ε(Q2) and the target tensorator at the unit; the latter is invertible for a lax monoidal functor with invertible ε. The right-unit calculation uses compatibility at (a,1) and the corresponding right-unit equations. Naturality of δ and of the two unitors transports these equalities along Q1(a)≅X. Thus the explicit maps satisfy all oplax monoidal axioms.
